Text: WHEN a member requests the balance, the loyalty service shall return the posted points and the pending points separately.
Rationale: Members ask why new points are not usable yet (S-03).

Text: WHEN a member opens the points history, the customer mobile app shall list the member's points transactions with the newest first.
Rationale: Support tickets ask for a history view (S-03).

Text: IF a member requests a redemption of fewer than 500 posted points, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the redemption with the reason "below minimum".
Rationale: Minimum redemption in the programme terms.

Text: WHEN the cashier scans a voucher, the POS shall request voucher validation from the loyalty service.
